name: studiomeyer
description: StudioMeyer MCP Suite for Claude Code. Hosted SaaS plugins: Memory (56 tools, knowledge graph), CRM (37 tools, contacts and pipeline), GEO (30 tools, AI visibility across 8 LLMs), Crew (13 expert personas). Plus the Academy MCP (open source, 12 public tools and 21 with a key). Hooks ship inside the plugins and work the moment a plugin is enabled, with nothing to paste into your settings. Magic Link authentication. EU Frankfurt hosting. Memory and CRM have a free tier plus Pro 9 EUR and Team 19 EUR per month. GEO, Crew and Academy are free.

plugins.name: studiomeyer-memory
plugins.description: Hosted AI memory with 56 tools. Knowledge graph, semantic search, contradiction detection, multi-agent namespaces, import from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and Perplexity. Free tier (5,000 calls/day), Pro 9 EUR/mo, Team 19 EUR/mo. Two hooks ship inside the plugin: recall on every prompt, and the memory session closes with your Claude Code session.

plugins.name: studiomeyer-crm
plugins.description: Headless CRM as an MCP server. 37 tools for contacts, companies, deals, pipeline, leads, follow-ups, notes, health scores and Stripe sync. Zero-Knowledge credential storage. Free (50 companies, 5,000 calls/day), Pro 9 EUR/mo, Team 19 EUR/mo. One hook ships inside the plugin: it looks up the customer behind every prompt, read-only.

plugins.name: studiomeyer-geo
plugins.description: Generative Engine Optimization. 30 tools to measure and improve AI visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, Meta AI and Copilot. Discovery stack audits, JSON-LD validation, schema generator, async job checks. Free tier, most tools need no API key. Ships no hooks on purpose: an audit sends your URL to eight providers and costs money, so it stays a command you run.

plugins.name: studiomeyer-crew
plugins.description: 13 expert agent personas: 8 standard roles (CEO, CFO, CMO, CTO, PM, Analyst, Creative Director, Support Lead) plus 5 specialists (Data Scientist, DevRel, Legal Advisor, Sales Engineer, UX Researcher), plus 3 multi-persona workflows. Zero extra API cost, runs inside your Claude subscription. Free, no paid tier. One hook ships inside the plugin: it reads your working directory and suggests a fitting persona. It writes nothing and calls no server.

plugins.name: studiomeyer-academy
plugins.description: Memory-First AI Operator School. 12 tools without an account, 21 once you enter an Academy API key while installing: lessons, quizzes, recipes, knowledge graph, certificates, AI tutor. Open source MCP server (npm mcp-academy, MIT). Free, no paid tier: all 6 levels, the full lesson tree and 58 written recipes are open. One hook ships inside the plugin: finishing a lesson pulls its quiz.
